description.zh: 座席工号；取值3-10位正整数
description.en: The agent ID. It must be a positive integer with 3 to 10 digits.

description.zh: 是否忽略重复下线报错；取值：0:不忽略 1:忽略 默认为0，不忽略
description.en: Specifies whether to ignore errors from repeated logout requests. Valid values are `0` (do not ignore) and `1` (ignore). The default value is `0`.

description.zh: 是否给座席发生kickout事件；取值： 0:不发送， 1:发送 默认为1，发送
description.en: Specifies whether to send a kickout event to the agent. Valid values are `0` (do not send) and `1` (send). The default value is `1`.

description.zh: 取值： 0:不解除绑定电话， 1:解除绑定电话 默认为0
description.en: Specifies whether to unbind the phone number from the agent. Valid values are `0` (do not unbind) and `1` (unbind). The default value is `0`.
